maps.title: SYSTEM MAP 1 / ARCHITECTURE
maps.subtitle: One portable root, explicit child scopes, one canonical task ledger
sections: Separate context, tasks, decisions and memory
boundary: One outer .SYSTEMX installation; child records are selected by name.
A chat or current directory does not silently select a child scope.
maps.description: The portable root keeps objective, plan, canonical tasks and focus. Named .SYSTEMXP children keep independent records under one outer toolchain.

maps.title: SYSTEM MAP 2 / TASK + EVIDENCE
maps.subtitle: Agent 0 coordinates; X, Y and Z return distinct evidence
sections: Agent 0 plans, assigns, integrates and reviews
X: event/time   Y: selected CLI task
Z: fixed evidence review, advisory score
Saved harness and optional BOT TODO snapshots
root delta compares; it does not contact providers
boundary: Provider output, a scorecard or a draft PR does not accept a task.
Agent 0 or the designated owner reviews the canonical result.
maps.description: The task and evidence cycle connects the objective and canonical task ledger to Agent X timing, Agent Y selected CLI work, Agent Z review, and owner acceptance.

maps.title: SYSTEM MAP 3 / GOVERNANCE
maps.subtitle: Alpha, Beta, Agent1 and the Access Matrix record intent
boundary: A workbook row, setting or named BOT folder grants no external access.
Host, GitHub and provider controls enforce real permissions.
maps.description: The governance map shows ten unset Agenda context settings, twenty default-deny Access Matrix roles, offline named BOT folders and advisory Agent1 assessment.

maps.title: SYSTEM MAP 4 / FIRST RUN + TOOLCHAIN
maps.subtitle: Preview, select a scope, then connect a host-owned process
sections: VS Code / Codex / Cursor / Kiro / JetBrains
DATA/ payload is locally ignored by Git
A source release is not an app deployment
boundary: The host launches the process with its own permissions.
No native MCP/ACP IDE binding or local secret symlink is installed.
maps.description: First-run and toolchain routes connect the reviewed CLI to host-owned IDE processes, selected project scopes, local DATA and separate release and deployment evidence.

agents.title: AGENT 0
agents.subtitle: Coordination, roster, integration and owner acceptance
prompt: Plan one task, show the roster, gather evidence,
then ask the owner to review acceptance.
boundary: Agent 0 coordinates canonical tasks and integrates results.
A roster entry or context packet grants no access.
agents.description: Agent 0 reads the selected-scope roster, coordinates canonical tasks, integrates evidence and asks the designated owner to accept work.

agents.title: AGENT X
agents.subtitle: Event history, timing and due-item records
prompt: Record this observed event and its time.
Show what is due; close only the reviewed record.
boundary: Agent X records time and due status; it is not a scheduler.
A due item sends no notification or external action.
agents.description: Agent X records events, due items and reviewed closure without scheduling execution or delivering notifications.

agents.title: AGENT Y
agents.subtitle: One selected CLI task and a bounded PR handoff
prompt: Prepare one assigned task for an installed CLI.
Return branch or PR evidence; do not merge.
boundary: Agent Y uses a selected CLI under host permissions.
A draft PR grants no merge or task-acceptance authority.
agents.description: Agent Y takes one explicitly assigned task through a selected installed CLI and returns bounded branch or PR evidence.

agents.title: AGENT Z
agents.subtitle: Fixed, versioned evidence review
prompt: Review this evidence against the fixed policy.
Score supported answers and show the delta.
boundary: Agent Z uses 100 fixed questions across 10 categories.
Its scorecard advises; it does not accept a task.
agents.description: Agent Z applies a fixed hundred-question evidence policy and returns a versioned advisory scorecard.

agents.title: AGENT ALPHA
agents.subtitle: Selected AUTOBOT references and optional Agenda
prompt: Find one relevant AUTOBOT reference for this task.
Leave Agenda unset unless I select an option.
boundary: Agent Alpha routes up to ten bounded references.
Agenda starts unset; no worker or scheduler starts.
agents.description: Agent Alpha routes selected AUTOBOT references on request; the ten Agenda context settings start unset.

agents.title: AGENT BETA
agents.subtitle: Named BOT and DOT workspace records
prompt: Set up one named BOT workspace.
Link reviewed intent to a canonical task.
boundary: The named folder records identity and task references.
It does not log in, launch a provider or grant access.
agents.description: Agent Beta records separately named offline BOT or DOT workspaces and advisory task or access links without connecting a provider.

agents.title: AGENT 1
agents.subtitle: Advisory security and access assessment
prompt: Review evidence and list .env names only.
Suggest rotation; never print secret values.
boundary: Agent1 catalogs 20 x 20 questions and ten event buckets.
Warnings do not prove a device clean or grant secrets.
agents.description: Agent1 offers warning-only security assessment, four hundred evidence questions and names-only dotenv migration review.
